component.name: Smart Folder Organizer
component.summary: Automatically categorize and organize files into clean subfolders

description.p: Smart Folder Organizer scans folders such as Downloads and Desktop, analyzes files by extension, MIME type, filename keywords, and optional document text inspection, and sorts them into tidy, categorized directories.

ul.li: Multi-layer classification engine (extension, filename keywords, and content-aware analysis)
Interactive preview list with checkboxes before moving any file
Safe collision resolution with automatic unique renaming (never overwriting)
Instant undo support to restore files to their original paths
CLI mode for terminal workflows and automated scheduling
Built with GTK 4 and Libadwaita following the GNOME Human Interface Guidelines

description.p: Initial release for Fedora Workstation and GNOME 45.
